## Logs, screenshots, or clips

Attach only the minimum evidence needed to review the bug.

- Redact tokens, account IDs, machine names, internal URLs, and personal data.
- Do not upload raw recordings, raw audio, or other sensitive captured data.
- If the problem may be security-sensitive, stop and use
  [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) instead of filing publicly.
